name: Virginia
checked: 2026-10-09; 2026-10-10 by N10 (the reader's own requests through election/source.py)
status_why: Enhanced Voting answered scripts; 2026-November-General is posted.
system: Enhanced Voting (enr.elections.virginia.gov), the Department of Elections' results site, the same platform as Georgia's; 133 localities as child sites.

results_page.label: Virginia Department of Elections: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

feeds.address: https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/Virginia (election list); https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/api/elections/virginia/<slug>/data (the election's data: contests, choices, votes, isOfficialResults, lastUpdated); files under https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/cdn/results/
feeds.updates: Every few minutes on election night.
feeds.note: jurisdictions/Virginia answered 200 JSON (122 KB) on 2026-10-09; it lists 2026-November-General (2026-11-03).

feeds.address: Same API with a locality's shortName (accomack-county, albemarle-county, alexandria-city, ...: 133 children)
va.py adds up a precinct-level CSV from the site (candidate, votes, party, locality, precinct, district, office); the Department also keeps apps.elections.virginia.gov/SBE_CSV/

races_in_feed: Federal, the special House of Delegates 20 contest, and every locality's November contests (county boards, city and town councils, school boards, constitutional officers where scheduled).
local: All 133 localities are child sites of the same platform; Fairfax and others also post their own pages (not checked).
how_counted: Early and mail ballots are reported in each locality's central absentee precincts.
count_order: Central absentee precincts (CAPs) carry early and mail ballots.
vote_types: Partly: Virginia reports early and mail ballots in each locality's central absentee precincts (CAPs), so the split is by precinct type rather than a column; usable for count order.

certify.body: the Virginia State Board of Elections
certify.rule: Meets on the first Monday in December (Va. Code 24.2-679).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: 2026-August-Democratic-Primary and 2026-August-Republican-Primary (official), and the posted 2026-November-General, kept in election_cache/replay/sources/<code>-<id>/ (kept 2026-10-10 by N10 for rehearsals)
scout_plan: Live-readable, and the Nov 3 election is already registered. Share one Enhanced Voting reader with Georgia: on election night read .../2026-November-General/data every 3 minutes, compare lastUpdated, and read locality children for local contests. Rehearse on 2024NovemberGeneral and 2025-November-General.
notes: Reader (N10, 2026-10-10): enhanced_voting. check() reads the election record's lastUpdated; fetch() reads <site>/results/public/api/elections/<j>/<id>/data (statewide totals, count groups, reporting units). The per-contest county breakdown (2.5 MB a contest) is not read.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
